rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Imaging Place of Service - Hospital Outpatient (POS 19, 21, 22) Care-Related

criteria.description: Patient is in active treatment for cancer
Planned or prior organ or stem cell transplant
Recent hospitalization for the same or related condition within the past 3 months
Imaging needed for continuity of care with a documented clinical reason
Planned surgery or procedure at the same hospital facility
Patient is currently pregnant

required_documentation: Clinical documentation of active cancer therapy, transplant history, recent inpatient discharge summary, or planned procedure
rules.review_notes: Hospital-based outpatient advanced imaging is indicated for care-related exceptions.

rules.policy_title: Evolent Place of Service Policy 2067 for Radiology (2026 Final)
rules.source_section: POLICY AND PROCEDURE / Advanced Imaging / Extenuating circumstances
rules.source_quote: Extenuating circumstances with any ONE of the following:
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Imaging Place of Service - Hospital Outpatient (POS 19, 21, 22) Extenuating Circumstances

criteria.description: Medical condition is urgent or emergent (patient could suffer harm if care delayed)
Patient resides in a nursing home or assisted living facility or is bedbound
Patient resides greater than 50 miles from the nearest freestanding imaging facility
Patient requires specialized equipment such as a mechanical ventilator or has history of difficult IV access
Moderate or deep sedation / general anesthesia is required for imaging
History of contrast allergy with systemic airway/anaphylactic symptoms
Patient has an implantable electronic device (CIED pacemaker/ICD or programmable VP shunt) and MRI is planned
Patient age < 18 and imaging facility is a dedicated pediatric center

required_documentation: Medical notes documenting device interrogations, anesthesia consultation, severe allergy history, or geographic distance
rules.review_notes: Hospital-based outpatient imaging indicated for clinical/anesthetic extenuating circumstances.

rules.source_section: POLICY AND PROCEDURE / Advanced Imaging / Specialized equipment or expertise
rules.source_quote: Severe claustrophobia and open MRI is needed and not available
rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Imaging Place of Service - Hospital Outpatient (POS 19, 21, 22) Specialized Equipment

criteria.description: Severe claustrophobia where open MRI is needed and unavailable at local freestanding facilities
Patient weight or body habitus exceeds weight/size limits for freestanding scanners
Specialized expertise or complex imaging protocol is needed that is only available at hospital facility

required_documentation: Physician notes documenting scanner bore/weight limitations, severe claustrophobia history, or specialized acquisition protocol
rules.review_notes: Hospital outpatient imaging indicated when specialized scanner bore, weight capacity, or technical protocol unavailable freestanding.

rules.clinical_service_or_procedure: Advanced Imaging Place of Service - Hospital Outpatient Setting (POS 19, 21, 22)

criteria.description: Imaging requested in hospital-based outpatient setting (POS 19, 21, 22)
Patient does NOT meet any care-related, extenuating circumstance, or specialized equipment criteria for hospital setting

required_documentation: Clinical records demonstrating absence of hospital-level clinical indications
exclusion_conditions: Hospital outpatient site of service is not medically necessary when clinical criteria for hospital setting are not met
rules.review_notes: Hospital outpatient site of care is not indicated if member does not meet explicit clinical criteria; redirects to freestanding facility.
